required_manual_checks.description: Map every currently missing gate:static PROVEN-suite requirement to the exact suite, environment source, execution phase, and an evidence-backed safe setup procedure. Distinguish local disposable proofs from production-specific proofs; identify any genuinely unavailable external prerequisite.

The report must not invent environment values, mark an unexecuted suite PROVEN, weaken gate:static, remove tests, or claim a full pass from a filtered run. Include the exact commands and observed exit results for any safe non-production proof actually executed.
Only apps/os/docs/PROOF-ENV-001.md changes. No 2A.2d implementation, test, gate, authorization, Coordinator runtime, production, or deploy changes; no use of production credentials.

title: Establish the controlled proof environment required by the 2A.2d gates
